summary: Iteration 108 — verified full paywall removal + 5 new features (FR/FA recipe lang pills, multilingual glossary, FR/FA weekly challenge, customizable quick tools, auto language detection). Backend: 16/16 pytest passed (/api/subscription/status pro=true for guest+admin, /api/recipes?collection_name=mikilab returns 0 locked and full `procedure` for all 121 recipes incl. 'Lievito Madre di Segale', /api/academy/weekly-theme in it/de/en/es/fr/fa). Frontend (mobile 390x844): no PRO teaser/lock icons on recipe list or detail (Segale + 18 Panettoni fully readable), Your Lab + Diagnosi + Piano IA open with no price screen, recipe-lang-fr/fa pills present and switch UI, glossary translated in DE/EN/ES/FR/FA (19 terms, RTL ok for FA), weekly theme translated (FR 'Farines & force (W)', FA persian), quick tools customize/6-limit/persistence/open all work, auto-detect starts app in FR with navigator=fr-FR and empty localStorage, no JS page errors navigating all 5 tabs in it/fr/fa. ONE requirement violation found: the Shop & Academy page still sells recipe bundles and PRO subscription.

minor.issue: Docs return locked=null instead of false (code only overwrites when truthy). Harmless today (frontend uses truthiness) but inconsistent with the API model.
Stripe payment endpoints still live and still reachable from the Shop UI, although the product is now fully free.

ui_bugs.component: Shop.jsx / AcademyHome (tab 'shop', reachable from Home button home-core-corsi)
ui_bugs.issue: PAYWALL STILL PRESENT: bundle prices €50 (Pasticceria) / €40 (Pane) / €20 (Panini) / €10 (Snack), CTA 'oppure abbonati PRO (tutto incluso) · €29,99/mese', copy 'Acquista il ricettario o abbonati PRO' and consulting 'Prenota e paga · €120'. Clicking these starts a real Stripe checkout. Violates requirement (A) 'niente a pagamento'.

Content is still framed as locked: 'Sblocca ricette e schede completando le sfide', 🔒 badges '3 sfide → Panettoni + Academy' and '6 sfide → Sblocca tutto', 'Registrati gratis per partecipare alle sfide e sbloccare i contenuti'. Everything is already free, so this copy is misleading.
Brand title truncated to 'M…' on 390px viewport in FR/FA (long 'Se connecter' / RTL login button squeezes the title).
When 6 tools are already selected, tapping a 7th does nothing with no feedback (no toast/disabled style) — user cannot tell why nothing happened.

integration_issues.issue: Pills recipe-lang-fr / recipe-lang-fa exist and switch the app chrome, but the recipe body (title, real_name, procedure, notes) stays in ITALIAN because recipes only have _de/_en/_es fields. Fallback should at least use the EN fields for FR/FA (or run the translate pipeline) — currently a FR/FA user reads an Italian procedure.

issues: Recipe picker uses the native browser <select> ('Scegli una ricetta…') instead of the shadcn Select used elsewhere (pre-existing)

action_items: Remove/neutralise all payment CTAs in sections/Shop.jsx and AcademyHome.jsx (bundle prices €50/€40/€20/€10, '€29,99/mese' subscribe, 'Prenota e paga · €120') — this is the last remaining paywall reachable from Home → Corsi.
Rewrite the challenge-engine and Home hero copy: content is no longer unlockable/locked ('Sblocca…', 🔒 badges) since everything is free.
Recipe detail in FR/FA still shows Italian content — add fr/fa recipe fields or fall back to EN.
Optional: delete dead paywall code (PaywallGate paywall branch ~200 lines, RecipeList buy-single/panettoni/all dialog + recipe-teaser block, backend _teaser_recipe/_visible) to avoid regressions.
Add feedback when the 6-tool quick-tools limit is reached.

PaywallGate.jsx keeps a full unreachable paywall UI + Stripe handlers behind `const hasAccess = true;` — dead code that can silently come back.
GET /api/recipes forces locked=False only when the value is truthy, leaving locked=null; set it explicitly to False for a consistent contract.
Glossary i18n JSON verified complete: all 19 terms have t+d for de/en/es/fr/fa (no missing keys).
